inputs.lyrics:
[intro]
[instrumental: heavy darbuka percussion, digital synth arpeggio, creating a hypnotic and contemplative loop]
[vocal: low growling]

[verse 1]
[vocal: staccato, rhythmic whisper-rap style]
ten years back at the dusty crossroads
signed with a kiss, my wish bestowed
silver coin for a golden throne
built my empire on a borrowed loan
sigils carved in the basement floor
now the shadow knocks at the iron door
blood moon rising, the clock strikes thin
time for the collector to let himself in

[pre-chorus]
[vocal: staccato, rhythmic whisper-rap style]
the runes are glowing red
the blood pact wants me dead
there's no way out
there's no more doubt

[chorus]
[vocal: spoken-word, fast whispered pacing, building pressure]
oh the hellhound is howling my name
burning white in a violent flame
drag me down to the glowing deep
where the ancient promises keep
my soul is the price for the gold I hold
the story of a demon’s bargain sold

[verse 2]
[vocal: low register, detached, cold precision]
hex on the mirror, blood on the lace
i see the hunger in a demon's face
cemetery wind blowing cold through the hall
i built the tower just to watch it fall
manifested power, intoxicating greed
now the beast is coming for the only seed
possession is a heavy chain
washing my legacy down the drain

[pre-chorus]
[vocal: staccato, rhythmic whisper-rap style]
silver turns to rust
diamonds turn to dust
he is here
the end is near

[chorus]
[vocal: spoken-word, fast whispered pacing, building pressure]
oh the hellhound is howling my name
burning white in a violent flame
drag me down to the glowing deep
where the ancient promises keep
my soul is the price for the gold I hold
the story of a demon’s bargain sold

[bridge]
[vocal: spoken-word, fast whispered pacing, building pressure]
i hear the claws on the hardwood floor
i hear the scratching at the basement door
the scent of sulfur, the heat of the pit
i signed the line and this is it

[chorus]
[vocal: spoken-word, fast whispered pacing, building pressure]
oh the hellhound is howling my name
burning white in a violent flame
drag me down to the glowing deep
where the ancient promises keep
my soul is the price for the gold I hold
the story of a demon’s bargain sold

[outro]
[vocal: haunting melody fading out]
down to the hollow
where the shadows follow
[vocal: whispering]
collect... the... debt.
[instrumental fade out]
